summary: Iteration 5: tested template intro preview (wizard step 2) and per-event colour schemes (wizard step 4, guest card, OG images, share page). Backend: new test file with 22 tests all pass; full suite 93/93 pass. Frontend: all requested flows verified on desktop 1920 and mobile 390 with no page errors.

issues: The preview applies auto per-event schemes, so the first event (Mehndi) shows emerald instead of the template's own palette after the intro (e.g. Warm Hearth shows light green). This may give hosts the wrong idea of a template's colours. Optional: preview with template colours, or show the event tabs so the switch is visible (the tabs are already shown).

critical_code_review_comments: TemplatePreview: eventId state is set once from demo.events[0]. It's safe because the wizard always has at least one event.
StepEvents ColorPicker defines the Swatch component inside the render, so it remounts on every render. This is harmless but could be pulled out.
SCHEMES/AUTO regexes are duplicated in eventColors.js and og_image.py by design. The comment notes they must stay in sync, so a shared JSON would be safer.

Music toggle only shows for templates with music (modern-minimal and boardroom have none); aria-label switches Mute music/Play music. OG PNGs differ per event (e1 green, e3 blue), and share v= is unique per event.
